tagline: Slow roads and open skies — solo or with the whole family, from the Karoo to Kyoto.

author.name: Your Name
author.shortBio: Retired, restless and South African. I travel solo when the road calls and with the grandchildren when the holidays do — and I write it all down so you can go too.

newsletter.heading: Postcards from the road
newsletter.blurb: One honest letter a month: where I went, what it cost, and the padkos worth packing. No spam, unsubscribe any time.

mediaKit.audience: Mostly South Africans aged 45–75 who plan, save for and take two or three trips a year — split between road trips at home and one bigger overseas journey.
